messages.subject: dirinla + spde
parts:
Hi INLA developers and everyone,

A quick question (not use if this is the right site), is it possible to include a spde term in a Dirichlet model using the "dirinla" package?
Thank you in advance
Juanmi

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] dirinla + spde
parts:
Hi,
No the dirinla package don’t support spatial models; it only supports fixed effects and plain random effects.
Finn
